spans.s:
खश m. (-शः)
 1. A mountainous country to the north of

India.
 2

. A
native of that country, considered as a degraded Kṣatriya.
 f. (-शा)
A kind of perfume, commonly Mura.
खष r. 1st cl. (खषति) To kill, to hurt or injure.

खस m. (-सः) Itch, scab.
 2. A man of a country or tribe considered to be
a degraded Kṣatriya: the Khasas inhabit the mountains surroun-
ding Kashmir.
 f. (-सा) The mother of the imps or goblins.

खशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Resting or dwelling in the air.
 E. ख and शी to
sleep, अच् aff.

खशरीर n. (-रं) A celestial or immortal body.
 E. ख and शरीर body.

खशरीरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Of a heavenly body.
 E. खशरीर and इनि aff.
खशेट m. (-टः) The Khalisa, a kind of fish: see खलेश.

खश्वास m. (-सः) Air or wind.
 E. ख the atmosphere, and श्वास breath.

खष्प n. (-ष्यं)
 1. Anger, passion. Violence, oppression.
 E. खन् to hurt, to
dig, प Uṇādi affix, न changed to ष.
खसगन्ध m. (-न्धः) A plant, commonly Kṣirakakolic.

खसम m. (-मः) A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint.
 E. ख heaven, and
सम equal, the same.

खसम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced in the sky, aerial, ethereal.
 E. ख, and
सम्भव birth.

खसर्पण m. (-णः) One of the Buddha or Bouddha saints.
 n. (-णं) Gliding
through the air.
 E. ख heaven, and सर्पण who goes to or in.

खसात्मज m. (-जः) An imp or goblin.
 E. खसा the mother of these beings,
आत्मज a son.

खस्तनी f. (-नी) The earth.
 E. ख earth, स्तन a breast, affix ङीष्.
खस्खस m. (-सः) The poppy.

खस्खसरस m. (-सः) Poppy juice, opium.
 E. खस्खस and रस juice.

खस्फटिक m. (-कः)
 1. Crystal, the sun gem.
 2. The moon gem: see सूर्य्यकान्त
and चन्द्रकान्त
 E. ख heaven, and स्फटिक crystal.

खाशि m. (-शिः) Name of a country to the east of Bengal: the Cossya
hills; also खाशिक m. (-कः.)
खाश्मरी f. (-री) A plant: see काश्मरी.
